description: A select field that opens a drawer with a search box and a filtered, optionally grouped list of options.
overview:
`SearchPicker` renders a field-style `DrawerTrigger` with the selected label and an up-down caret. Pressing it opens a `Drawer` with a search input and a scrollable list of options.

Typing filters options by label, case-insensitively. Options with a `group` are shown under a group heading. Choosing an option selects it, closes the drawer and clears the search. Use it when the list is too long to scan, such as countries, cities or frameworks.
usage:
Pass `items` as an array of `{ value, label, group?, disabled? }`. The `SearchPickerItem` type is exported.

Use it uncontrolled with `defaultValue`, or controlled with `value` and `onValueChange`; the value is a string or `null`. `emptyText` shows when nothing matches.

examples.WithValue: Starts with a preset selection via `defaultValue`.
examples.Grouped: Cities grouped by country, with custom placeholders.
examples.WithTitle: Adds a heading to the drawer with `title`.
examples.WithCloseButton: Shows a close button in the drawer.
examples.Disabled: A disabled field that cannot open the drawer.
examples.Invalid: Shows the error border and tint with `invalid`.
examples.Controlled: Holds the value in state and prints the selection below.
examples.Floating: Detaches the drawer from the screen edges.

SearchPicker.items: The options, each with `value`, `label` and optional `group` and `disabled`.
SearchPicker.value: The selected value when controlled, or `null`.
SearchPicker.placeholder: Text shown in the field when nothing is selected.
SearchPicker.searchPlaceholder: Placeholder and label of the search input. Defaults to `Search...`.
SearchPicker.emptyText: Text shown when no option matches. Defaults to `No results found.`.
SearchPicker.title: Heading shown at the top of the drawer.
SearchPicker.disabled: Prevents opening and dims the field.
SearchPicker.floating: Insets the drawer from the screen edges.
SearchPicker.showCloseButton: Shows a close button in the drawer. Defaults to `false`.
SearchPicker.invalid: Applies the error border and background.
SearchPicker.accessibilityLabelledBy: Links the field to a visible label.

accessibility:
- Each option is a button that exposes `selected` and `disabled` states.
- Each group has the `group` role and is labelled by its name.
- The search input is labelled by `searchPlaceholder`.
- Without a `title`, the drawer is labelled by the placeholder or `accessibilityLabel`.
notes:
- The list stays between 40% and 60% of the window height, and taps work while the keyboard is open.
- The field uses `bg-control`, `border-danger` with a `bg-danger` tint when invalid, and `bg-control-disabled` when disabled; the tint is stronger in dark mode.
- The search input disables autocorrect and autocapitalization.
